title: Kissed Crunchy Peruvian Potatoes Tacu Tacu
description: A citrusy and gooey Peruvian dish featuring high heat cooking oil, perfect for midnight cravings, this tacu tacu is egg-free-friendly and served in a copper mug.
instructions: Heat the corn oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Fry the diced potatoes in batches until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the potatoes from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a large bowl, mix together the fried potatoes, diced onion, minced garlic, lime juice, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Using a spoon or your hands, shape the potato mixture into small patties.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and cook the patties for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are crispy and golden brown.
Serve the tacu tacu in a copper mug, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Repeat the process until all the potato mixture is used up.
